display.purpose: Hero headline and champion name; Saira condensed 800.

body.purpose: Reading text and data; Saira at 92% width, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Floating panels: the home lane board.

shadows.name: button-glow
shadows.purpose: Under the gold primary button only.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All transitions: lane board re-deal, splash blur-in, link arrow nudge, tier board fade-in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:0 22px; border-radius:6px; font-weight:700; background:#e4b65c; color:#1b1305; box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgb(228 182 92 / 0.6); transition:background .16s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform .16s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:#f2cb7c; transform:translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:4px; padding:4px; border:1px solid rgb(214 178 106 / 0.14); border-radius:10px; background:#0b1220; } .ds-seg button { min-height:40px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#98a4bb; font-weight:600; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background:#15213a; color:#e8ecf4; box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 #e4b65c; }

components.name: Win Bar
components.description: Win rate against an even 50%: the fill runs from the centre mark, cyan right, red left.
components.css: .ds-win { position:relative; display:block; width:120px; height:4px; border-radius:2px; background:#15213a; } .ds-even { position:absolute; left:37.5%; top:-3px; bottom:-3px; width:1px; background:#98a4bb; } .ds-fill { position:absolute; left:37.5%; width:30%; top:0; bottom:0; border-radius:2px; background:#5ed6c8; }
